title: Al-Qahhar: The Divine Name the Quran Only Ever Uses to Argue About Number
excerpt: Al-Qahhar occurs six times, and all six read al-Wahid al-Qahhar. Every one sits inside an argument about how many gods there are — and the only command built from its root forbids you to use it on an orphan.
seo_title: Al-Qahhar: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Qahhar appears 6 times in the Quran, always preceded by al-Wahid, the One. What the name means, how al-Jalalayn glosses it, and why 93:9 forbids the root to you.
